rationale: Clear accidental fire damage to the policyholder's own home (kitchen cabinets and smoke damage), arising from a cooking accident with no third-party involvement. This is straightforward property damage covered under the homeowners policy.
claim_summary: Policy POL-1001 (Alex Doe): Kitchen fire claim filed following grease flare-up while cooking yesterday evening. Claimant promptly extinguished fire with extinguisher. Damage limited to kitchen area: charred cabinets directly above stove and smoke damage to ceiling/walls. No injuries; rest of home unaffected. Homeowners policy active with $250,000 coverage limit, $500 deductible. Classified as property_damage with high confidence (0.98). Severity: medium—estimated repair scope includes cabinet restoration, smoke remediation, and interior finishing. Ready for field adjuster inspection and damage assessment.

case_facts.damage_description: charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls in kitchen area

rationale: Direct wind damage to insured structure (roof shingles). Clear property damage claim with no third-party liability or theft elements involved.
claim_summary: Claim for wind damage to back porch roof overhang. Approximately four shingles blown off during windstorm last weekend. Estimated repair cost: $400. No water intrusion or secondary damage reported. Policyholder: Jordan Lee (POL-1006). Policy deductible: $2,500. Claim is below deductible and will be out-of-pocket for policyholder. Documented for records and future reference.
